title: Exponential PSD rank of positively shifted matching matrices

issues.description: The step from PSD rank of the slack matrix T_n(0) to the minimum size of an exact semidefinite lift is only sketched: properness by restricting to a face, and the affine-to-linear reduction. It leans on Gouveia–Parrilo–Thomas without checking their exact hypotheses. The argument is standard and looks correct, but it is brief.
issues.evidence: 'For completeness, an arbitrary lift can be restricted to the smallest face of the PSD cone containing its feasible section... A linear functional equal to one on the slice therefore absorbs the translation.'

coverage: Read the whole main proof path: Introduction, Section 2 (local averaging), Section 3 (orthogonal splitting), Section 4 (Fourier smoothing theorem), Section 5 (expander and parity functional), Section 6 (normalization lemma and proof of Theorem 1.1), and Corollary 1.2. Appendix A (matching smoothing) is stated as independent and Section 6 never cites it, so I only skimmed it. Checks: brute-forced the local averaging operator K for small k and d (k=8,10; d=2,4). The marginal is exactly uniform and tr(K^2) matches formula (2.x) exactly. Checked the central-binomial identity by hand. Checked the multiplicity argument (nonconstant invariant subspaces have dimension at least k/2, via disjoint transpositions and the A_k argument). Ran 3000 random tests of the orthogonal splitting lemma; the worst ratio to the bound 2^{L-1} was 0.24. Re-derived by hand the Fourier-coefficient stacking identity, the diagonal and off-diagonal overlap bounds, the one-step bound Phi_{i+1} <= 2 Phi_i, and the trace <= sqrt(rank)·Frobenius conversion. Checked the expander constants: H(.05) ≈ 0.199 <= 0.21, the 41.75 exponent, and log(2e) + 45(.21 + .95 log .55) ≈ -14.4 < -8. Checked the parity functional's well-definedness, its rank-one blocks via the triple identity, and that it gives every disagreement indicator value 0. Checked the tail arithmetic: L^{2t} r^{3/2} 2^{t/2} λ^{-τt} <= n(4L)^{-2t} when λ^τ >= 64L^4 and r <= 2^t. Checked the uniform error 2n(4L)^{-t} + n(4L)^{-2t}, the functional bound 2n·4^{-t} → 0, and the normalization lemma (John-type log det argument).
main_claim: For every fixed 0<ρ<1, the matrix with entries |M∩δ(U)|−1+ρ (U an odd set, M a perfect matching of K_n) has PSD rank at least 2^{cn}, where c>0 does not depend on ρ. As a corollary, every exact semidefinite lift of the perfect matching polytope has size 2^{Ω(n)}.
sibling_notes: Family 126 had no sibling entries on the hive board when I checked. The proof is self-contained and does not depend on any companion paper. The local averaging lemma, the splitting lemma and the Fourier smoothing theorem are stated abstractly, so a sibling that reuses them can rely on these checks. The constants are astronomically large (L=2^99, C_L=2^{2^99−1}, k enormous) but are all fixed before n, so this is fine.
